Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- Dropdowns in the Animations tab now have a "Disabled" entry, so you can turn one group back off without rescanning.
- New Reset button on each mod you've changed through PoseKit: it puts just that mod back to your normal Penumbra settings, leaving your other mods alone.
